name: 5,6-MDO-DMT
summary: 5,6-MDO-DMT, or 5,6-methylenedioxy-N,N-dimethyltryptamine, is a lesser-known chemical compound of the tryptamine family. It is the 5,6-methylenedioxy derivative of dimethyltryptamine (DMT) and is an analogue of 5-MeO-DMT. In his 1991 book TiHKAL (Tryptamines I Have Known and Loved), Alexander Shulgin lists the dose as greater than 5 mg smoked and the duration as unknown.

uses.en: It is a little-known research compound described in Shulgin's work.
uses.zh: 它是Shulgin著作中描述的一種鮮為人知的研究用化合物。
uses.zhHans: 它是Shulgin著作中描述的一种鲜为人知的研究用化合物。

fact.en: It is DMT with a methylenedioxy bridge across the 5 and 6 positions of its ring. Shulgin listed it in TiHKAL but reported its duration as unknown.
fact.zh: 它是在DMT環的第5與第6位之間架上亞甲二氧基橋。Shulgin在《TiHKAL》中列出了它，但表示其作用時間不明。
fact.zhHans: 它是在DMT环的第5与第6位之间架上亚甲二氧基桥。Shulgin在《TiHKAL》中列出了它，但表示其作用时间不明。
